p: Dominion and fear are with him: His purpose is to prove that although God may try and afflict the just, yet soon after he sends prosperity, and because he did not do so to Job he concludes that he is wicked.
and upon whom doth not his: Who can hide him from his presence?
be justified with God: That is, be just in respect to God?
the stars are not pure in: If God shows his power, the moon and stars cannot have the light which is given to them, much less can man have any excellency but from God.
